content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Silver Pavilion, not silver at all, but the sand garden will hush you."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A slow canal-side stroll where even the carp seem to be saying goodbye."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Torii gates stacked like a fox’s promise—walk until the city noise forgets you."},{"poi_id":"p14","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Steel wheels and old signals, all polished and waiting for a curious hand."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"Gold leaf on water, best seen before the tour buses learn to queue."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"The garden does the talking; the pond has been listening since the fourteenth century."},{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Walk slowly and let the bamboo do its hush."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Wooden stage, hillside air, and the city laid out like an old scroll."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A thousand gilded figures stand in the half-light, patient as centuries."},{"poi_id":"p11","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Stone Buddhas and painted screens, history with its shoes off."},{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Nightingale floors squeak underfoot, so no one sneaks up on the shogun."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m5","note":"Snack your way through the market lanes, then watch the knife work at a stall that has been at it for generations."},{"poi_id":"p19","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A calm, plant-based table that still treats halal seriously, right when the crew needs a proper sit-down."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Walk the old geisha district slowly; the wooden facades do most of the talking."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Lanterns, narrow alleys, and the sound of someone practising shamisen behind a screen."}]}
Slow lanterns, vermilion gates, gold and bamboo, then a quiet farewell — every must-do is in, shoes off and eyes up.
